baseline_scope: Historical TRANSPORT-only vmax=1.5 amax=20; matched original 8 seeds only, not a 30-seed baseline.

oracle.selection: First two normal successes in original smoke order; after one timeout, additionally tested the next two normal successes. All outcomes retained.

strict_bucket_misses.phase_chain: REACH -> GRASP -> PULL -> TRANSPORT -> DROP -> DONE
strict_bucket_misses.causal_attribution: Unresolved without matched strict-bucket baseline; no systemic transport regression established.

viability_review.rationale: All original 30 seeds accepted with grasp/detach/place; no premature or incidental detach, branch break, timeout or observed stall fallback; no normal systematic regression. Strict VLA bucket is separately 29/30, not promoted to 30/30. Three of four current-interface tracking replays complete strict bucket success; one 20s timeout retained. No evidence of systemic TRANSPORT-limiter task regression.
remaining_limitations: Strict bucket miss for seed 1000408; no matched historical strict-bucket trace for causal attribution.
Tracking oracle seed 1000106 times out at DROP start under unchanged 20s budget.
Legacy REACH instantaneous mismatch remains recorded and is not an acceptance blocker.

reach_policy.description: legacy contact-sensitive approach; not retimed; instantaneous envelope mismatch retained

transport_policy: free-space transport; retimed for student executability
